rules.interaction: Local ordinance administered by the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations.
rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rent increases in buildings of 5 or more units under its Rent Control Ordinance; properties with 1 to 4 units are exempt.
rules.key_value: Rent control for 5+ unit buildings; 1-4 unit properties exempt (cap amount not stated on page)
rules.coverage_conditions: Properties of 5 or more units, unless a permitted exemption is granted
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other exemptions by request to the Office
rules.quoted_span: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control

notes: Page is navigation-heavy and states only the rent control ordinance (Chapter 260) and the 1-4 unit exemption. It names no algorithmic rent-setting ban (no Code 218-12), no just-cause, deposit or fee rule.
